start.title: Tallow and Salt
start.text: Orren the chandler has three open barrels in his workroom and a problem: one shipment of tallow has begun to sour, and the salt meant to preserve it was stored damp. He offers coin for an hour of competent hands.

choices.text: Sort what can still be saved

buckets.flavourText: You separate the clean fat from the rancid edges and find the dampest salt before it contaminates the rest.
Most of the stock can be saved, though Orren catches two pieces you would have kept.
The smell makes everything seem equally suspect. Orren takes over before more is lost.

good_work.title: Useful Hands
good_work.text: Orren stops hovering after the first quarter hour. By the end, he is talking while he works: wax prices, lamp shortages, which households are buying more candles than usual.

choices.text: Ask about the unusual candle orders

fair_work.title: An Honest Hour
fair_work.text: You save enough stock to make the work worthwhile. Orren pays what he promised, minus nothing, and says that alone distinguishes him from half the town.

poor_work.title: Not Every Skill Transfers
poor_work.text: Orren waves away your apology. "You stopped when you knew you were guessing. That puts you ahead of most apprentices." He gives you a smaller coin and a candle stub for the trouble.

rumour.title: Candles for Empty Rooms
rumour.text: Orren says three dozen candles went to a house whose owner died last winter. The buyer paid in old silver and refused delivery. "Came back twice to collect them himself," he adds.

paid.title: Warm Wax, Small Coin
paid.text: You leave with the smell of tallow in your clothes and enough coin to make the hour worthwhile.

decline.title: Another Pair of Hands
decline.text: Orren shrugs and calls for his niece. The work continues without you.
